The '''Tionese''' were a cultural group of [[Human/Legends|humans]] native to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. The Tionese established a proud ancient civilization within the Tion Cluster in opposition to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
[[File:Tionese_Task_Force.jpg|thumb|right|Tionese Task Force above [[Felucia/Legends|Galuch]]]]
The Tionese began circa [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], when a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] "[[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]]" reached the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. The Tionese wasted no time, establishing a new society, including technological advancements like [[Beam tube/Legends|beam tubes]] and their own version of the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. This local hyperdrive variety fused bits of ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] technology with fixed-position [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacons]], which allowed travel within a defined area but was dangerous when venturing outside the "lighthouse" network. This kept the Tionese isolated from the rest of the galaxy for millennia, though they occasionally encountered the growing [[Hutt Empire]].

From [[25,130 BBY]] to [[25,100 BBY]], [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] (the son of a pirate whom in the [[Cronese Sweeps]] had carved for himself his own domain: the [[Kingdom of Cron]]), attempted to vanquish the rival [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and become the master of the entire [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] during the [[Xim Wars]]. This campaign included the devastation of the once-lush Hutt world of [[Boonta/Legends|Ko Vari]] in [[25,102 BBY]]. However, at the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], the Hutts unleashed their newly-found army of [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]], and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] mercenaries on Xim's [[war-robot]]s.

According to Tionese lore, Xim was killed in combat, though he had actually been captured by the Hutts and would die as a slave at the palace of [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv|Kossak the Hutt]] on [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. However, his treasure ship - the [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']] -escaped to the planet [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]], where it would remain hidden for millennia. Following the battle, the [[Treaty of Vontor]] was signed by the Hutts, Klatooinians, Vodrans, and Nikto. This treaty set the Hutts up as eternal overlords of the three other species and of the Si'Klaata Cluster.

Following that, Xim's empire collapsed into several feuding states, including the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion]], the [[Indrexu Confederation]], the [[Jaminere Marches]], the [[Keldrath Alignment]], the [[Kingdom of Cron]], and the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]]. Later, the Tionese states came into contact with the Galactic Republic and attempted to conquer it by traveling on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] though the Tionese were halted by the establishment of the outpost world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. During the [[Tionese War]] in [[24,000 BBY]], the Galactic Republic came into conflict with the Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion which resulted in the capitals of both governments - [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and Desevro - being bombed by [[pressure bomb]]s. However, the Republic won the war by using its agents to stir up trouble in Hutt space, thus worsening the divide between the Hutts and Tionese.

Within a century, most of the Tion Cluster had joined the Republic. As a result, the once proud Tion Cluster became a backwater. However, the planet [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] became the headquarters of [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] sometime during the [[Old Republic era|Galactic Republic era]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Tion Cluster was divided the into three sectors: [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]], the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], and the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] (the former territory of the [[Cronese Sweeps]]).
